summary.management: At 2026-07-12 18:00:00 UTC, One automated check detected a condition of “ipsec tunnel down — cloud private path” affecting lab-svc. The condition is ongoing (2h 00m elapsed). Synthetic path impact is confirmed; actual real-user impact was not confirmed because relevant real-traffic telemetry was insufficient. The fault condition is confirmed and the affected domain has been localized; the underlying root cause remains under investigation. Decision: Open incident — Customer impact and fault are confirmed by independent evidence; restoration workflow should begin. Escalation follows the policy thresholds stated in the decision section.
